events.summary:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Indiana...
Illinois...

Wabash River at New Harmony.

.Due to recent heavy rain, the Wabash River has risen above flood
stage at New Harmony. The river is forecast to continue rising to its
crest at 15.7 feet early Friday morning.

For the Wabash River...including New Harmony...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Wabash River at New Harmony.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:30 PM CDT Tuesday the stage was 15.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to a crest of 15.7 feet
early Friday morning. It will then fall below flood stage early
Sunday morning.
- Flood stage is 15.0 feet.
